lines.text: A social media photo shows a scene of destruction after a building collapse. The image captures two individuals standing on a ladder, amidst debris and damaged structures.

A black car is parked on a cracked road with a large crack running through it. There are people standing around the car, including a police officer and a man in a red shirt. The scene appears to be in a city setting with a building in the background.

A social media photo from Twitter shows a scene of a collapsed building with debris scattered around. People are gathered around the rubble, some wearing helmets and vests, indicating a rescue operation.
